description:
About Owner

Owner is the AI-native system local business owners use to succeed, starting with restaurants.

We’re building the system that replaces the many tools owners use to run their business.

It powers everything from the restaurant’s website, online ordering, CRM, POS, and more.

Product philosophy

Most small business software makes owners do the work to get what they want: sales growth and profit growth. Owner does the work for them agentically.

Our system drives demand, converts it, and helps operators run their business day to day. As it improves, the business improves with it.

Using Owner should feel like having a team of great operators, engineers, and marketers working for you.

Our vision

We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online.

But it’s not just restaurants that need our help. Most local businesses are struggling with these same problems. Huge technology corporations are taking their customers, bleeding their profits, and making it hard for them to survive.

Once we nail the solution for restaurants – we’ll scale it into every other local business type.

In the future we envision, tens of millions of local business owners will use our technology to succeed in the digital age.

Our traction

Since 2020, we've generated tens of millions in revenue and processed over a billion dollars of online orders. 1 in 5 Americans have used an Owner.com website.

More importantly, we’ve helped over 20,000 restaurant owners, and saved them nearly $200 million in fees.

Our team

Our team is now in the low hundreds. We’ve got top talent from the most successful companies in SMB software, including: Shopify, HubSpot, DoorDash, ServiceTitan, Rappi, Faire and Stripe.

We’ll be scaling even faster in 2026 to keep pace with our customer growth.

Where we work

Owner is a remote-first, global company headquartered in San Francisco, with a sales hub in Toronto. For a few of our roles we prioritize in-person collaboration at one of our office locations. Most of our teammates are distributed throughout the globe. Please review the role description and discuss with your recruiter for more details on location!

Role Overview

The Voice AI team builds the AI that answers a restaurant's phone. When a guest calls, our agent picks up, takes a pickup order validated against the live menu, answers questions about hours and the restaurant, and sends the order straight to the kitchen, or hands the call to staff when a person is the better answer. We also build the tooling that lets restaurants go live without an engineer in every launch. If a restaurant joins Owner, our team is how its phone turns into orders and revenue instead of missed calls, and how guests get what they need while staff stay focused on service.

This is not a typical backend or ML role. Real-time voice is unforgiving: a guest on the line notices every extra half-second, every interruption handled badly, and every wrong modifier. The team works across streaming speech and LLM pipelines, telephony, turn-taking, and recovery when speech, model, or network services fail mid-call, and we measure quality on real calls, not demos. We're scaling well beyond our first live restaurants, and we automate everything we can, including with AI.

As the Engineering Manager, you'll lead this team and own its delivery and technical direction. You'll build a team that ships quickly with a high bar for quality, and you'll own hiring, coaching, career development, and performance management. Your scope spans the real-time voice experience, the systems that connect conversations to restaurant menus and ordering, and the tooling and engineering support that help restaurants launch and run reliably.

This role is 100% remote and can be based anywhere in the United States or Canada. For San Francisco-based candidates: we have a new HQ in the Presidio for optional in-person collaboration.

Why we’re looking for you

Owner helps independent restaurants grow their business. The phone is still how a huge share of restaurant orders start, and too many of those calls go unanswered or get passed to a busy host. Our voice agents answer those calls, take orders, and help guests get what they need while restaurant staff focus on service. Real restaurants are already using it, and the product has proven the idea.

The next challenge is scale. Improving call quality, making onboarding self-serve, and keeping the agent reliable across more restaurants takes dedicated engineering leadership. Today, voice delivery, technical direction, and engineering support are spread across existing leads. We're hiring an Engineering Manager to own them, grow the team, and set the bar for how we build real-time voice AI at Owner.

Our Tech Stack

  • Voice & Real-time: LiveKit, Gemini, streaming STT/LLM/TTS pipelines, full call lifecycle persisted

  • Agents & AI: Vercel AI SDK, tool calling, agent loops, conversation state

  • Backend: Node.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, PostgreSQL

  • Frontend & Tooling: React, TypeScript, restaurant onboarding and launch tooling

  • Observability & Evals: Datadog, Braintrust, LangSmith, call replay and regression testing

The impact you'll have

  • Lead, hire, and grow the Voice AI team. Give direct feedback, support career growth, manage performance, and help engineers take ownership of systems and outcomes.

  • Set technical direction and turn product goals into focused plans. Partner with Product, Design, and Customer Success to prioritize work around restaurant needs and follow through from development to rollout.

  • Improve the conversation experience: response latency, turn-taking, interruptions, and recovery when speech, model, or telephony services fail.

  • Make phone ordering dependable. Help the team handle menu options and modifiers, validate orders, prevent duplicate submissions, and hand calls off to restaurant staff when needed.

  • Establish quality measures grounded in real calls. Use call reviews, automated evaluations, and regression testing to improve order accuracy, task completion, and reliability as models and prompts change.

  • Own the team's production operations and engineering support. Build clear escalation paths, on-call practices, and incident follow-through, and turn recurring customer issues into product improvements.

  • Scale restaurant onboarding and launch tooling so more restaurants can go live with less manual engineering work.

What we’re looking for

  • Experience managing software engineers, with ownership of hiring, coaching, career development, and performance. You can build trust, rally a team around a goal, and help experienced engineers do their best work.

  • A strong software engineering background and recent hands-on work. You're comfortable setting architecture, contributing code, reviewing designs, and debugging across services.

  • Experience building and operating production voice AI or real-time conversational systems, with depth in streaming speech pipelines or speech-to-speech models, telephony, latency, turn-taking, and interruptions.

  • Experience with LLM tool calling, conversation state, and evaluations for systems whose responses vary. You can connect model behavior to whether a customer successfully completes a task.

  • Ownership of production reliability, including observability, incident response, and recovery from model, network, and downstream service failures.

  • Strong product judgment, clear communication, and a record of working closely with cross-functional partners to ship useful products in a fast-moving environment.

Compensation and benefits

  • The estimated starting base salary range for this role is $240K-$260K USD depending on level, location and experience, plus a generous pre-IPO equity package. If you feel the range is too low, still please apply and let us know!

  • Other benefits include comprehensive health coverage, work from anywhere (remote-first workplace), unlimited PTO - plus extra fun perks!

Notice - Employment Scams

Communication from our team regarding job opportunities will only be made by an Owner team member with an @owner.com email address.

We do not conduct interviews over email or chat platforms, and we will never ask you to provide personal or financial information such as your mailing address, social security number, credit card numbers or banking information. If you believe you are being contacted by a scammer, please mark the communication as "phishing" or “spam” and do not respond.
